subject: french
title: Subjects & Verbs
welcome_lead: Subjects, having and giving in class.
meta_desc: KS3 French: school subjects, classroom verbs.
final_note: Talk about what you do at school.

walkthroughs.body_html: Subjects: les maths, le francais, l'anglais, l'histoire, la geographie, les sciences. All take 'le, la, les, l''.
'Avoir' (to have) is one of the two most important French verbs. J'ai = I have. Tu as = you have. Il/elle a = he/she has.
'J'etudie le francais' = 'I study French'. Etudier = to study. To say I like a subject: 'J'aime les maths' (I like maths).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I like coffee' in French?
options: J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'his sister' and 'her sister' in French?
options: His = son, her = sa - based on owner's gender.
Both are 'sa sœur' - possessives agree with the OBJECT possessed, not the owner.
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I was using my computer when the phone rang' in French?
options: J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
J'utilisais mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
J'ai utilisé mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
